    <div class="meta">About</div>
    <h1>Business training, data science tools.</h1>
    <p>I started out as an accounting major at the University of Ottawa, quickly realized it wasn’t for me, and switched to business technology management. Then I spent two years at the Department of National Defence turning SAP and CRM data into dashboards and automations people actually used.</p>
    <p>That work showed me how much a good question and clean data matter. I came to Georgetown for the statistics and machine learning, and now I build data pipelines and dashboards for the School of Medicine. In between, I automated subscription and newsletter reporting at AL-Monitor.</p>
    <p>I like problems where the hard part is getting the data right: reconciling sources that don’t agree, catching the records a report silently drops, and turning the result into something a busy person can read in a minute.</p>
    <p>Outside of data, I love horse riding. Every new place I visit, I try to find a ranch and take the horses out for a ride.</p>
    <div class="skills">
      <div><h4>Analysis &amp; ML</h4><p>Regression, classification, clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN), PCA, t-SNE, NLP (TF-IDF, sentiment, topic modeling), A/B testing, Bayesian inference, ARIMA</p></div>
      <div><h4>Languages &amp; data</h4><p>Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, NLTK), R (tidyverse, ggplot2), SQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, ETL pipelines, D3.js</p></div>
      <div><h4>BI &amp; platforms</h4><p>Power BI (DAX, star schemas), Looker Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps, AWS, Git</p></div>
    </div>
